This petition is filed for quashing of summoning order dated 13.09.2024 passed by the 1st Judicial Magistrate, Roorkee, District Haridwar and the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No.2002 of 2024 "State Vs. Imran & others", under Sections 498A, 323, 506 of IPC and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, qua the petitioners on the basis of compromise/settlement arrived at between the parties.

5. In view of the fact that a Compounding Application was filed by the parties before this Court, this Court, vide order dated 18.11.2024, had directed the parties to appear before the Secretary, DLSA,
Haridwar 2024:UHC:9067 in order to get their statements recorded and to verify the compromise deed.

6. Pursuant to such order, Secretary, DLSA, Haridwar has submitted report dated 20.11.2024 which indicates that the parties have settled the dispute amicably and have also verified the contents of the compromise.
7. In view of the above, Compounding Application IA No.1/2024 is allowed.

As a consequence thereof, summoning order dated 13.09.2024 passed by 1st Judicial Magistrate, Roorkee, District Haridwar as well as the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No.2002 of 2024 "State Vs. Imran &
others", are hereby quashed, qua the petitioners.
